title: Te Patunga Hihiri
intro: I te wā o ngā whakamātautau atua, i karangatia tētahi wairua ki te mahi tino ngohengohe. I whakatipuria i roto i te whenua pakoko, i tipu ake tēnei tangata hei whakaatu i te whakapono me te manawanui. I te wā i whakahaua ai he patunga tapu e te moemoeā, kāore rātou i ruarua. Ko tā rātou kōrero he pou tokomanawa o te aroha.
clues: Ko ahau te whakautu ki te inoi i tatarihia mō te wā roa a te poropiti nui.
I mahue māua ko tōku whaea i tētahi awaawa ururua, ko ā māua kai he tāte me te wai anake.
I tipu ake ahau hei poropiti, e mōhiotia ana ahau mō tōku pono me tōku manawanui.
I āwhina ahau i tōku pāpā ki te whakaara i te turanga o te whare tapu i whakatapua ki a Allah.
I te kōrerotanga mai a tōku pāpā i tētahi moemoeā hei patu i ahau, ka whakahoki ahau, 'Meatia te mea i whakahaua ki a koe.'
I whakahonoretia e te Atua taku ngohengohe mā te tukunga mai i tētahi hipi toa i te rangi hei utu mōku.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Ka makaia ki roto i te ahi mura
Te horomia e te ika nui
Te whakamatautauria ki te mate kino

outcome.label: Hua
options: I utua ki te hipi toa nui
I tangohia mai i te tohorā
I hoatu he rangatiratanga me te whakaaro nui
outcome.answer: I utua ki te hipi toa nui

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
